_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Golf (Card Game) - Player {player_id}.
Goal: Get the lowest total score in this single round. If columns share the same value, they are summed as 0.
Card Values: A=1, 2-10=face value, J/Q=10, K=0

Actions (use exact brackets):
- '[draw]' - Draw from deck
- '[take]' - Take from discard pile
- '[swap X Y]' - Swap drawn card with position X (row) Y (column)
- '[discard]' - Discard the drawn card

board.drew:
O di ile wa tsaya: {card}
Jaanong o tlhoka go [swap X Y] or [discard]
board.took:
O di ile wa tsaya: {card} mo pile ya go tlhokela
O tlhoka go [swap X Y] le yone (ga go na go tlhokela)
board.peeked: O di ile wa leba ka poso ({row},{col}): {card}

options.final_turns: Mafelo a bofelo! Dikamano tsa gago: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: O tshwanetse go: [swap X Y] (o ka se kgone go latlha dikarata mo mokgokoloseng wa ditlatlana)
options.swap_or_discard: O tlhoka go: [swap X Y] or [discard]

hand.header: Col: 1 2 3 Go tswa mo go wena.

action_desc.swapped: Player {pid} o fentse {new} le {old} ka poso ({row},{col})

message.knocked: Motshameki {pid} o iteilwe! Moatlelete mongwe le mongwe yo mongwe a ka nna gape mo mothalong.
message.final_round: Player {pid} {reason}! Ba bangwe ba ba tsayang pele ba na nngwe

invalid.wrong_action: Sebetse ka kitso e le nngwe: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], or [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Thoto ya matlakala e setse e le lolea!
invalid.must_draw_first: O tlhoka go tsaya pele, [draw], [take], [knock], or [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Ga o ka ke wa latlha karata e e tserweng mo mokgokoloseng ono. O tshwanetse go a ananya.
invalid.have_drawn_card: You have a drawn card. You must [swap X Y] or [discard] it.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: O tlhoka karata e o tsereng mo go yone gore o kgone go ananya.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: O tlhoka karata e o ka kgonang go latlha.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Poso ke ntle. Tsaya lori 1-{max_row}, kolom 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: O ka se kgone go kokota o sa dirisa karata e nngwe. Feleletsa tiro ya gago pele.
invalid.already_knocked: Mongwe o setse a fentse motshameko ono.
invalid.already_revealed: Karata eo e setse e senotswe!
